name: floorplan
short: Serve the Pixel Agents office and mirror Discord presence into it
description: Hosts the Pixel Agents office webview through the Red Web Dashboard and serves its WebSocket protocol directly, turning Discord guild presence into animated characters. Browses and loads Pixel Index layouts, and owns the office layout editor gated by corridor's Keyholder permission tier.
end_user_data_statement: This cog transmits Discord user IDs, guild IDs, display names, presence status, and short message activity snippets to browsers connected to the Pixel Agents office. It stores one shared office layout and seat assignments globally.
install_msg: Requires corridor and pixelagents (both auto-loaded). Configure who may edit the office layout via [p]corridorsettings (the Keyholder permission tier), then enable a guild with [p]floorplan enable.
author: Pixel Agents HQ Contributors
